items.title: What's in the US-Iran agreement?
items.description: The 14-paragraph memo includes an end to fighting, an agreement that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, and a $300bn redevelopment package for Iran.

items.title: Moscow hit by largest Ukrainian attack since start of Russia's full-scale war
items.description: A refinery and a shopping centre were burning after almost 200 Ukrainian drones struck an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

items.title: Suspected gang leader shot dead in flower bouquet ambush at airport
items.description: The gunmen concealed their weapons behind flowers and stuffed toys while waiting for the victim outside Guayaquil airport.

items.title: Gunfire and explosions heard at Niger capital's airport
items.description: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

items.title: Japan ramping up defence is 'critical' to prevent war, Defence Minister Koizumi tells BBC
items.description: Japan needs to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined it since World War Two, Shinjiro Koizumi says.

items.title: Lawyer in high-profile Ugandan treason case charged with related offence
items.description: Uganda's military chief had boasted of "the hurt and pain" he would inflict on Erias Lukwago, who was arrested earlier this week.

items.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
items.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

items.title: Iran sends tankers loaded with oil past US military blockade
items.description: Three Iranian tankers loaded with crude oil have passed the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, ship-tracking data shows.

items.title: Search for six-year-old Ebola patient after armed men storm DR Congo hospital
items.description: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.

items.title: Serial killer who murdered eight women in Long Island town imprisoned for life
items.description: In fiery exchange, judge sentenced him to three life sentences plus 25 years to life on four other charges, all running consecutively.

items.title: The Ring and Lilo & Stitch actress Daveigh Chase dies aged 35
items.description: Chase died from sepsis following a bout with meningitis in a Los Angeles hospital, her longtime manager told the BBC.

items.title: Trump says he will visit India as frosty relationship with Modi thaws
items.description: Trump made the announcement during chat where he also vowed to protect India.
